create_health_servicer: create a HealthServicer instance to manage gRPC health check status for multiple services
set_service_status: set the serving status of a named service using HealthServicer set method
check_service_health: check the current health status of a specific service via the Check RPC method
watch_service_health: watch for health status changes on a service using the Watch streaming RPC method
enter_graceful_shutdown: enter graceful shutdown by setting all services to NOT_SERVING and blocking future status updates
